analysis:
On 12 May 2020 Modi announced a 'special economic package' of Rs 20 lakh crore, described at the time as equivalent to about 10% of GDP, to respond to the COVID-19 lockdown.

Break-ups published by news outlets and PRS Legislative Research show the total combined new announcements with earlier measures (including the Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Package) and with Reserve Bank of India liquidity operations. Several analyses noted that only part of the total was additional central government fiscal spending.

A report based on an RTI reply stated that only around 10% of the package had been disbursed. The Rs 20 lakh crore headline therefore overstated new central government spending, so the claim is recorded as misleading.
notes: quote_english is the wording used in PIB and press reports; quote_is_verbatim=false. The PIB pages returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch, so their content is taken from search-result text. The RTI-based Free Press Journal report is used for the disbursal figure; its publication date could not be confirmed.
